units.source_text: 二女公子相貌也很娇艳优雅，其端详又胜于乃姐，是个绝代佳人。

en.t: The second young lady was also charming, graceful, and beautiful, and in her composed elegance she surpassed even her elder sister; she was a peerless beauty.

units.source_text: 红梅大纳言想道：“若将此女配给寻常之人，实在万分可惜。

en.t: The Red Plum Grand Counselor thought, "It would be a terrible pity to marry this girl to an ordinary man.

units.source_text: 如果匂兵部卿亲王来求婚，倒可使得。”

en.t: If Prince Niou, the Minister of War, were to come seeking her hand, that would do very well."

units.source_text: 匂皇子在宫中等处看到真木柱所生小公子时，常常唤他前来，和他一起玩耍。

en.t: Whenever Prince Niou saw the young son born to Makibashira at court or elsewhere, he would often call him over and play with him.

units.source_text: 这小公子聪明颖悟，从他的眼梢额角上可以推知其前程之远大。

en.t: The boy was bright and quick-witted, and from the look of his eyes and forehead one could sense the great future that lay ahead of him.

units.source_text: 有一次匂皇子对他说道：“你回去对大纳言说：光叫我看见你这个弟弟，我心里不满意呢。”

en.t: Once Prince Niou said to him, "Go home and tell the Grand Counselor that I am not satisfied with being shown only you, the younger brother."

units.source_text: 小公子回家去对父亲说了，红梅大纳言笑逐颜开，庆喜夙愿可以成遂了。

en.t: The young boy went home and told his father, and the Red Plum Grand Counselor broke into a broad smile, rejoicing that his long-cherished wish might now be fulfilled.

units.source_text: 便对人说：“一个才貌双全的女子，与其入宫而屈居人下，不如嫁给这位匂皇子。

en.t: He then said to others, "For a woman blessed with both talent and beauty, it would be better to marry Prince Niou than to enter the palace and live beneath another's rank.

units.source_text: 我能如愿以偿，悉心爱护这位女婿，寿命也可以延长呢。”

en.t: If my wish comes true and I can devote myself to cherishing this son-in-law, it may even lengthen my life."

units.source_text: 但须首先准备大女公子嫁皇太子的事。

en.t: But first he had to prepare for his elder daughter's marriage to the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 他在心中祈祷：“但愿春日明神佑护，让皇后出在我们这一代。

en.t: In his heart he prayed, "May the Kasuga deity protect us and allow an empress to arise from our generation.

units.source_text: 那么，先父太政大臣为弘徽殿女御失败而抱恨长终，其在天之灵也可获得安慰了。”

en.t: Then the spirit of my late father, the Chancellor, who died in bitterness over the failure of the Kokiden Consort, may find comfort in heaven."

units.source_text: 就送大女公子入宫当太子妃。

en.t: He therefore sent his elder daughter into the palace to become the Crown Prince's consort.

units.source_text: 世人盛传：皇太子非常宠爱这位妃子。

en.t: People widely said that the Crown Prince loved this consort very dearly.

units.source_text: 但她不曾熟悉宫中生活，身边又没有能干的照顾人，故由继母真木柱夫人陪伴入宫。

en.t: But she was not yet used to palace life, and she had no capable attendant close at hand, so her stepmother, Lady Makibashira, accompanied her into the palace.

units.source_text: 真木柱十分爱护这位女公子，照顾得无微不至。

en.t: Makibashira loved this young lady deeply and cared for her with the utmost attention.
